plan.notes: Source: the official York College (CUNY) Catalog, Computer Science BS program page (https://york-undergraduate.catalog.cuny.edu/programs/COMPSCI-BS). Term-by-term sequence transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official catalog degree map '2025-Present | Computer Science BS | 4 year Plan' (Total DegreeMap Credits 120; Degree Map Effective Catalog Year 2024 -), as published in York College's official catalog PDF export for the Department of Mathematics & Computer Science (PDF generated 2026-05-11; identical 8-semester sequence verified in the 2026-02-02 export). Course codes, titles, credits, semester placement, and requisite-group text transcribed from that official map; catalog_year '2025-2026' reflects the degree map's '2025-Present' name and the source PDF's 2025-2026 publication. Caveats: (1) The degree map sequences CS 351 Algorithm Design and Analysis in Year 2 Spring, while the catalog's Major Requirements - Required Courses list names CS 451 Operating Systems (not CS 351); transcription follows the published degree map faithfully. (2) The May 2026 catalog PDF export's requirement-group text for CS 341 additionally lists 'COREQUISITE: MATH 261' (Foundations of Advanced Mathematics); the February 2026 export's single-column rendering of the same requisite group (021918) shows only 'PREREQUISITE: [MATH 141 OR MATH 225] and CS291', and MATH 261 is not scheduled anywhere in the published degree map, so it is not included as a requisite here. (3) Placement details from the official requisite groups (not course requisites, documented here): ENG 125 requires passing writing-skills/exemption; CS 172 requires MATH 104 or placement with corequisite MATH 120 or MATH 121; MATH 121 requires math placement scores or MATH 120; foreign-language placement via the World Languages department. (4) CS 401 requires CS 341 and [ENG 126 or a WRIT 300-level course]; only the specific codes CS 341 and ENG 126 are listed as prereq codes. (5) Computer Science majors must pass CS 341 with a C grade or better (official program requirement). (6) Major electives (official program requirements, not individually sequenced in the map): complete at least 2 of CS 334/377/381/382/391/392/452/461/465, AND at least 1 course from that CS list plus MATH 230/243/333/335/336/395; the map's elective slots are placeholders to be filled under advisement. (7) Degree requirements: 120 credits minimum, 2.0 GPA minimum, three Writing Intensive courses including one upper-division WI in the major (CS 401 carries the WRIC writing-intensive attribute).
